description:
Part (a) Part demotion of the existing building, as shown on the enclosed drawings clearly marked in red 'demolitions'. The existing single storey building is to be partially demolished, including a lock-up garage now part of the site. The timber sheds in the rear area are to be removed. At the rear, a 2000 addition on two floors is to be formed. To the Evelyn Road frontage, following removal of the lock-up garage, the new first floor will be extended to incorporate the entrance hall and wheelchair lift to bathroom and bedroom.
Part (b) Also demolition of a kitchen and bathroom facility, both single storey. The existing structure is to be raised to form a first floor to the new building.
